chars.NOURA: a young Moroccan woman in her late 20s with long dark wavy hair in a low ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow oversized hoodie and light blue jeans
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman in her early 30s wearing a burgundy hijab and a long olive-green cardigan over a black dress

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook style, vertical. In a small modern bedroom of a Casablanca apartment, NOURA stands in front of her open wooden wardrobe, half the hangers empty, holding an empty hanger up, eyebrows raised in confusion, face clearly visible, seen from the bedroom doorway, head-to-waist framing, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook style, vertical. In the hallway of the apartment, NOURA peeks into a laundry basket full of SISTER's clothes, searching for her own missing top, while SISTER walks past in the background carrying folded towels, unaware. Both faces visible, subjects centered. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook style, vertical. NOURA walks out of a clothing shop in a Casablanca street holding several shopping bags, frustrated annoyed face, rolling her eyes, centered, head-to-knees framing. No text, no shop signs with letters.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook style, vertical. In a Moroccan apartment kitchen with a teapot on the counter, NOURA asks SISTER with an accusing gesture, pointing at her own hoodie; SISTER shrugs with open palms, shaking her head, denying firmly. Both faces visible, subjects centered. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook style, vertical. At night in the bedroom lit by a small lamp, NOURA kneels by an empty open drawer, looking over her shoulder with suspicion toward the half-open bedroom door, where only a dark shadow of a man is faintly visible in the hallway, no face. NOURA's face visible, centered. No text.
